title: Expect query results to match source
description:
This Expectation will check if the results of a query matches the results of a query against another Data Source.

ExpectQueryResultsToMatchSource facilitates the execution of SQL or Spark-SQL queries     across two data sources and compares their results. It validates that the results from     the target query match those from the source query within a specified threshold.

Args:
    target_query (str): A SQL query to be executed for this Data Asset.
    source_data_source_name (str): The name of the source Data Source to compare this Asset against.
    source_query (str): A SQL query to be executed for the source Data Source.
    mostly (float): Successful if at least `mostly` fraction of values match the Expectation.

Returns:
    An [ExpectationSuiteValidationResult](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/terms/validation_result)

Supported Data Sources:
    [PostgreSQL](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/application_integration_support/)
    [BigQuery](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/application_integration_support/)
    [Snowflake](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/application_integration_support/)
    [Databricks (SQL)](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/application_integration_support/)
    [Redshift](https://docs.greatexpectations.io/docs/application_integration_support/)
Data Quality Issues:
    Multi-Asset
